title: Art Pop
tagline: Pop songwriting shaped by experimentation, concept, and visual imagination.
summary: Art pop uses the clarity and reach of pop while making room for unusual structures, production, and concepts. Its artists may draw on avant-garde ideas, theatrical performance, or unexpected sounds without abandoning memorable melodies. The result is a flexible space where popular songwriting and artistic experimentation meet on equal terms.

pillars.name: David Bowie
pillars.why: David Bowie repeatedly connected accessible songs with theatrical personas, studio experimentation, and ambitious visual ideas.

pillars.name: Kate Bush
pillars.why: Kate Bush built a singular pop language through adventurous arrangements, expressive vocals, and self-directed production.

pillars.name: Roxy Music
pillars.why: Roxy Music paired sophisticated pop forms with art-school presentation and a willingness to challenge rock conventions.
